description: Idempotently set the account webhook URL. Reads the current webhook (GET /user/webhook); if a different one exists it is removed (DELETE /user/webhook/{id}) before creating the new one (POST /user/webhook). dry_run=true (default) previews the change.

url.description: Webhook URL to receive Panda events

name: panda_action_set_webhook
title: Set Account Webhook
